extDescription.message: Record the audio of the current tab and save it as MP3 or WebM. Everything stays in your browser.

statusIdle.message: Records only the sound of the current tab.

statusRecording.message: Recording. You can keep listening as usual.

statusPaused.message: Paused. Resume or stop when you are ready.

statusFinished.message: Recording stopped. Choose a format to save it.

statusSaving.message: Saving… Long recordings take a few seconds to convert to MP3.

noticeNotSaved.message: The file was not saved. Your recording is still here.

noticeTabClosed.message: The tab stopped being available, so recording stopped. Save what was recorded.

errBusy.message: A recording is already in progress or waiting to be saved.

errNothingToSave.message: There is no recording to save.

errLost.message: The recording is no longer in memory. Record again.

errSave.message: Could not save the file ($1). Your recording is still here; try again.

settingShortcutSave.message: When you stop with the shortcut

settingAskWhere.message: Ask where to save each file

errStart.message: Could not record this tab ($1). Chrome does not allow recording its own pages, such as settings or the Web Store.
